quote:
You carry a quiet ache inside your chest. 
You hide the sorrow behind a gentle smile. 
No one notices the heavy weight you bear. 
You walk through crowds feeling completely alone tonight. 
The world demands strength from a fragile soul. 
Even the stars grow tired of burning out. 
Let yourself rest before the darkness takes over.
